mapper.sql: id, label, key, value, description, is_active, data_version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO config (id, label, key, value, description, is_active, data_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{label}, #{key}, #{value}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{dataVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM config WHERE label = #{label} AND key = #{key} AND is_active = TRUE
